description: This file defines a SwiftUI view component 'OpenClawChatComposer' that provides a user interface for composing and sending chat messages within a chat application. It includes features like session and model selection, attachment handling (images and files with platform-specific implementations), input editing, and sending controls. The code also contains auxiliary classes and utilities for handling image pasting and file uploads specifically for macOS.

classes.name: ChatComposerTextView
classes.description: A custom NSViewRepresentable wrapping a NSTextView for message input on macOS, supporting onSend and image paste handling.

classes.name: ChatComposerNSTextView
classes.description: A custom NSTextView subclass that intercepts key events and pasteboard data to support sending messages via Return and pasting images.

classes.name: ChatComposerPasteSupport
classes.description: A utility enum providing static methods for handling image and file attachments from pasteboard data, supporting multiple image formats and file URLs.

methods.name: makeCoordinator
methods.description: Creates the coordinator for the NSTextView delegate, managing text changes and send actions.

methods.name: makeNSView
methods.description: Creates and configures the NSScrollView containing the NSTextView for text input.

methods.name: updateNSView
methods.description: Updates the NSScrollView and NSTextView state, managing focus and text synchronization.

methods.name: pickFilesMac
methods.description: Opens an NSOpenPanel for selecting image files on macOS.

methods.name: handleDrop
methods.description: Handles file drops on macOS, adding dropped files as attachments.

methods.name: loadPhotosPickerItems
methods.description: Loads image data from PhotosPickerItems asynchronously on non-macOS platforms.
